dedupe_keys.name: irrigated fields of kherson and zaporizhzhia oblasts before and after the kakhovka dam destruction 2019 2025

description: This dataset maps irrigated fields in Ukraine's Kherson and Zaporizhzhia oblasts every year from 2019 to 2025, spanning the destruction of the Kakhovka Dam on 6 June 2023, which cut irrigation for most farms on the east bank of the Dnipro. The maps come from a semi-supervised machine learning framework combining Sentinel-2 and Landsat imagery with CHIRPS rainfall and FAO WaPOR water productivity data. Researchers at the University of Maryland published the annual GeoTIFF layers on Zenodo in August 2026 as a free download under CC BY 4.0, accompanying a manuscript under review. Coverage is regional for the two oblasts. Caveats: the maps are classifier outputs whose versions differ by year, and the paper describing accuracy was not yet published. Simulation uses: quantifying how a dam failure cascades into loss of irrigation service, for cascading failure, resilience and conflict hazard exposure studies. Related records: GMIA-Next global irrigated areas (data-gmia-next-global-irrigated-areas-30m) and the worldwide historical dam failures database (data-worldwide-historical-dam-failures-database).
